HRA Analysis: LAYDOWNLUNA (4) led last time out before handing over to Pinnie and running a solid second there albeit beaten a long way by the win. She has seemingly been building into some better form and appears to find a very winnable race. ITS TRIXTON TIME (3) ran a good race two starts ago when finishing fourth behind Natty Pagger in a race which may have been a touch tougher than this one. He generally likes racing from the stands and should be close enough in the small field. BUCKLES (5) was able to win a similar race to this one last time out when facing a 20 metre handicap early and running over the top late. He appears likely to get a similar type of run in this race and should run well again. TRINITY RAINBOW (1) was slowly away early last time out before making a break losing valuable ground at the start and was still able to run a solid third there behind BUCKLES (5). She has a handicap advantage in this race and is likely to be fancied for the placings. SELECTIONS: LAYDOWNLUNA (4), ITS TRIXTON TIME (3), BUCKLES (5), TRINITY RAINBOW (1) SUGGESTED BET: LAYDOWNLUNA (4) to win.

BLACK VIPER (7) ran well last time out finishing fourth having been forced to do the work outside the leader in the QBRED Trotting Final on Saturday. This race looks considerable easier than his latest outing and he should run well. BUSTER DAN (5) has been racing well and appears to find a suitable race where he should be able to find a position up on speed again with a safe getaway. He raced without cover last time out and was beaten a very long way but can be forgiven for that effort given the quality of the winner Pinnie. LOCHINVAR SON (4) was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on well there in a race taken out by Buckles. He should get a good run close to the speed again in this race and is close to a win. ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (6) ran well last time out finishing fourth behind Buckles at this track. He made a break two starts ago which took him out of play there but with his best manners this time he can play a part. SELECTIONS: BLACK VIPER (7), BUSTER DAN (5), LOCHINVAR SON (4), ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (6) SUGGESTED BET: BUSTER DAN (5) to win.

HUNGRY FOR MORE (8) is exceptionally well bred being the sister of Captain Shuffles. Frankie Ferocious and Savage Seas. She went around in a recent trial at Redcliffe when getting back and flying into second behind well performed older pacer Bonnies Cam. FEELING HAPPY (2) was shuffled back to near last in her latest outing at this track having begun slowly. She was then able to get to the line nicely late not beaten far in seventh. She draws more favourably this time and should be running on late. NORTHVIEW CRUNCHA (1) is the sister of $539,000 earner Northview Hustler who recently retired having had a terrific career in QLD. She won a recent trial in reasonable time beating What Is His Name and looks ready to run well on debut. GO MINNIE (7) secured a good run last time out on the pegs and wasn’t beaten too far in sixth behind Sweet Leah Jane. She draws poorly in this race but does have some tactical speed and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: HUNGRY FOR MORE (8), FEELING HAPPY (2), NORTHVIEW CRUNCHA (1), GO MINNIE (7) SUGGESTED BET: HUNGRY FOR MORE (8) to win.

BARRACUDA (6) was forced to race without cover last time out at this track over the 2138 when just coming up short behind Interpretation. He battled away well enough in second to suggest he should be very hard to beat in a race of this nature and is likely to have derived benefit from his two first up outings. BETTOR BE BOHDI (7) led last time out and looked likely to be well beaten turning for home but was able to rally well and run third there behind Crippa Max. He draws poorly in this race and may be shuffled back and will need the race run to suit. EDWARD JAY (8) was forced to make a wide run into it from back in the field having drawn poorly and was able to get into fourth in a race taken out by Heza Maywyn. He should get a good run through early in this race and can be running on late. STUDLEIGH ANNE (1) was shuffled a long way back on the pegs last time out at Redcliffe before finishing it off well enough into sixth late up the sprint lane. She is likely to have derived good benefit from the outing and draws well in this race. SELECTIONS: BARRACUDA (6), BETTOR BE BOHDI (7), EDWARD JAY (8), STUDLEIGH ANNE (1) SUGGESTED BET: BARRACUDA (6) to win.

THREENTWO (9) was able to find the front last time out and was beaten there by Favreau who sat outside of her and won. She does seem to be a horse which races better over the mile and could be better suited in this race. THE REAL ROCKETMAN (8) draws awkwardly inside the back row and will likely need some luck at some stage to get into the clear. Drew poorly last time out and was running on into eighth behind My Ultimate Rudi. KEAYANG TARA (5) secured a good run last time out and was finishing it off well behind Take Courage. She is likely to get back again in this race from a wide draw and should be running into it late. DEEP REGRET (3) has just moderate gate speed but does find a race where he may be able to press through early and find the lead. He SELECTIONS: THREENTWO (9), THE REAL ROCKETMAN (8), KEAYANG TARA (5), DEEP REGRET (3) SUGGESTED BET: THREENTWO (9) to win.

KIKI MEISTER (2) was very good last time out when running into fourth behind Pure Grunt in the QBRED Triad final last start in a race the winner rated 1.52 for the 2138. He draws well in this race and has gate speed which may see him work to the lead in the early stages. COSMIC FLYER (3) was running on strongly last time out into third behind Mister Reactor. He looks like he may have found a race where he could settle a touch closer this time and could be dangerous late. DRAGON (4) was forced to race without cover last time out in a race taken out by Im Boo where he battled on very well there for a close up second. He may be left to do the work again in this race but showed last start he is capable of still fighting out the finish. MACH ASSASSIN (1) was able to lead and win an easier race last time out over the 2040 at Redcliffe. He steps up in grade but has an ideal draw to offset the jump in grade and should secure a good run in this race. SELECTIONS: KIKI MEISTER (2), COSMIC FLYER (3), DRAGON (4), MACH ASSASSIN (1) SUGGESTED BET: KIKI MEISTER (2) to win.

BITE THE EAR MIKE (3) was able to secure a good run on the pegs early last time out and ran a good third there behind Pure Grunt and stablemate James Alfred. He is likely to find this considerably easier than his latest outing and he draws to advantage over his main rivals in this race. MAGIC JUJON (10) was shuffled back early last time out in the final of the QBRED Triad series before getting clear late and flashing into third behind Stripes and Amylee. She should get a good run off the speed in this race and should be running on strongly again. MISTER SEASIDE (9) ran well last time out in a strong race over the 2138 which was taken out by Ruggards Gee Tee. He should get a good run through early in this race and should be close enough to run on into the finish again. I OF THE HURRIKANE (2) has some early speed and may be able to get across to the pegs before taking a trail on one of the more fancied runners. He hasn’t been at his best in recent outings but could be an improver given a favourable run in this race. SELECTIONS: BITE THE EAR MIKE (3), MAGIC JUJON (10), MISTER SEASIDE (9), I OF THE HURRIKANE (2) SUGGESTED BET: BITE THE EAR MIKE (3) to win.

PLANET DOWNS (1) should have the gate to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race. Did plenty of work last time out and was able to run a good third there behind My Ultimate Rudi who was able to secure a soft run on the pegs. BETTOR CHEER (6) looks the class dropper in this race but does need to overcome a wide draw in this race. He finished in last position in his latest outing but it was a considerably stronger race taken out by Gem Punter Pete over Dragon. ITS BACK PAGE NEWS (7) led two starts ago and was able to prove too good there leading all the way at Redcliffe. She backed that up with another good effort when having less luck in running last time out. She will need luck from the draw but should run well. GIDUP CAPTAIN (8) should get a good run through in the early stages of this race. He may be tested in this company over the 2138 but is racing well enough to potentially sneak into the top 4. SELECTIONS: PLANET DOWNS (1), BETTOR CHEER (6), ITS BACK PAGE NEWS (7), GIDUP CAPTAIN (8) SUGGESTED BET: PLANET DOWNS (1) to win.

BRACKEN WARRIOR (3) has good gate speed and may be able to work his way to the lead in the early stages of this race. He led last time out and set a genuine tempo in front there before being run down finishing third behind Prince Joy and Rock It Baby. He is likely to have derived benefit from his two outings and should be ready to run a good race third up. STUDLEIGH MARK (7) was a good winner two starts ago running down Docta Feelgood over the 2040 at Redcliffe before backing that up with a good placing. He draws poorly outside the front but does look fairly well graded in this race. MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (4) has had no luck in recent outings. He was forced to do the work last time out when sitting outside the leader in a race taken out by Mister Reactor at this track. JEFFCOATE (1) hasn’t quite been racing at his best in recent outings. He may be suited sitting close to the speed on the pegs this time and could be an improver in this race. SELECTIONS: BRACKEN WARRIOR (3), STUDLEIGH MARK (7), MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (4), JEFFCOATE (1) SUGGESTED BET: BRACKEN WARRIOR (3) to win. OVERVIEW:ENJOY LIFE (9) remains undefeated from seven starts and followed a first up win at Melton in a sensational mile rate of 1.52.4 with a victory in the Tasmanian Derby. He is very strong and will prove hard to beat again. MIDNIGHT MOTH (4) looms as the logical danger. He smashed the track record at Geelong on July 03 then finished off well from a rearward position at his latest close second. He has the best draw out of the major chances and will prove hard to beat. SOHO WASHINGTON (10) won three races in succession at Penrith in June/July and has performed very well in Victoria previously. He is awkwardly drawn but has too much ability to dismiss. SECRET SERVICE AGENT (6) is building up a consistent record and broke through for a deserved victory at Geelong last outing. He is versatile and is capable of taking the next step forward. LOWRIDER (7) was run down after pushing forward to find the lead last outing but his form prior was sound so he is worth another chance. SELECTIONS: ENJOY LIFE (9), MIDNIGHT MOTH (4), SOHO WASHINGTON (10), SECRET SERVICE AGENT (6)

OVERVIEW:LUVTOBEUPTOME (1) returns from a Queensland campaign and is drawn to go close. He won the Queensland Derby Consolation at his latest attempt, has performed well at the trials since and is perfectly drawn to suit his racing pattern. SOHO TRUMP (4) was resuming since an eighth in the Bathurst Gold Chalice when he won in a slick mile rate of 1.51.8 at Menangle. His building up a good strike rate and should prove hard to beat again. STAR VISION (11) remains undefeated from three starts and was resuming since May when he worked forward to find the lead mid-race and held off his rivals to win at Melton. He is facing his toughest test but appears to be capable of taking the next step forward. CO CAPTAIN (6) was a dominant winner in easier grade last outing and has claims along with SOHO PARK AVENUE (9) and ZANDA MAN (10). SELECTIONS: LUVTOBEUPTOME (1), SOHO TRUMP (4), STAR VISION (11), SOHO PARK AVENUE (9)

OVERVIEW: REWATCH (2) is a classy New South Wales trained pacer, which has the best draw out of the major chances and will prove hard to beat. He finished a close up third in the South East Derby three starts ago and was unplaced in the Queensland Derby last outing. NEPTUNITE (9) is facing his toughest test but his form in New South Wales has been extremely strong and he blitzed his rivals at Wagga last outing. He has won six of his eight starts to date and is not to be underestimated. SOHO CHARMER (11) led from a wide draw and was able to hold off his rivals to score at Menangle last outing. He finished unplaced in the Queensland Derby prior and has the class to test this field. SOHO PIASTRI (4) led throughout and dashed well clear at the end to win in a mile of 1.52.9 at Newcastle last outing. He is drawn to give another forward showing. The Emma Stewart trained pair THE FINAL DANCE (5) and SEASIDE BOY (7) are both racing well enough to feature prominently. SELECTIONS: REWATCH (2), NEPTUNITE (9), SOHO CHARMER (11), SOHO PIASTRI (4)

OVERVIEW: LE CARDINAL (1) possesses a brilliant turn of speed and is perfectly drawn to suit his racing pattern. He recorded a sizzling mile rate of 1.52.3 when he scored at Melton two starts ago then produced another big finish at his latest close second. ENJABONARLO (5) is resuming since a win over Soho Charmer at Menangle in June. He was a comfortable trial winner at Goulburn on August 13 and he should give a bold showing under these conditions. MAJOR BLITZ (6) won five races in succession prior to a Queensland Derby campaign, where he finished third in a heat of the Queensland Derby and followed with an unplaced effort in the Final. He is a fast beginner and should make his presence felt. SOLS ME NAME (8) is resuming since a win at Geelong in June. He has had a win and a third in two recent trial performances and should gain an economical run behind LE CARDINAL (1) so he is not without a chance. SELECTIONS: LE CARDINAL (1), ENJABONARLO (5), MAJOR BLITZ (6), SOLS ME NAME (8)

OVERVIEW:THE NITESHIFT (4) is a nicely bred gelding, which has created a good impression at his first season of racing having won four of his six starts to date. He led throughout to score in a slick mile of 1.51.7 on June 20 and has been freshened since his latest eighth. He should go well at his Victorian debut. THIS IS HEAVEN (1) is another New South Wales trained pacer that is drawn to give a good showing. He boasts a very consistent record and was run down on the line ($1-22 fav) at his latest close second. MOST EXCITING (5) appears to be the best of the local chances after some very good Metropolitan form at Melton. He set up a genuine tempo in the lead when a big winner at Melton two starts ago then endured a tough run at his latest second. BLAZING HIGH (3) has been racing well at Menangle and finished a close second behind Romanee at his latest performance. He should be prominent throughout from his good draw. SELECTIONS: THE NITESHIFT (4), THIS IS HEAVEN (1), MOST EXCITING (5), BLAZING HIGH (3)

OVERVIEW:MOUNT BARKER BOY (4) overcame a tough run to win at Ballarat two starts ago then finished a close second behind stable mate Star Vision at Melton, where he led out then took cover. He is a good chance of leading throughout under conditions. CARDIGAN DAN (10) is returning from a Queensland campaign, where he finished tenth in the Queensland Derby. He finished fourth in the Nutrien Classic Final in May and will appreciate a slight drop back in class for this assignment. ROCKY ROCKS (5) has only missed a placed once in twelve starts to date and chased hard when a close second in the Tasmanian Derby last outing. He is a versatile gelding and looms as one of the leading chances again. ROMEO (1) was resuming since a win at Wagga in June when he performed well below expectations ($1-45 fav) after leading at Cranbourne. He is much better than his latest effort suggests and is worth thought from the pole position. SELECTIONS: MOUNT BARKER BOY (4), CARDIGAN DAN (10), ROCKY ROCKS (5), ROMEO (1)

OVERVIEW: PRE EMINANT (8) enjoyed a prosperous juvenile season having been placed in six of her seven starts. She hasn’t raced since a narrow defeat in last season’s Super Series Grand Final in November but she had two trials in June and she is the class runner of this field. BETTOR BEACH (5) recorded a sensational win at Melton, where she raced clear to score by ten lengths in a mile rate of 1.53.1 before heading off for a Queensland Oaks campaign. She was well beaten in the Queensland Oaks but is worth another chance under these conditions. KEAYANG PASSION (1) is resuming since an eighth at Menangle in May. She finished fourth in the New South Wales Oaks prior and she is drawn to give a bold showing. FROSTY DROP (7) began quickly from a wide draw and found the front on the first turn when second behind Liberty Star Dust at Kilmore. This race is a little harder but he is capable of filling a place. SELECTIONS: PRE EMINANT (8), BETTOR BEACH (5), KEAYANG PASSION (1), FROSTY DROP (7)

OVERVIEW: QUATRO MOTH (6) lacks solid racing but she is a very classy filly and will take beating if she is somewhere near her peak form. She worked forward to find the lead and was run down late in a slick mile rate of 1.53.6 at Bendigo last outing. ISTHISTHEREALLIFE (8) had little luck from a wide draw and finished fourth behind The Final Dance at Melton last outing. She performed extremely well from the front running role at her three starts prior and has claims despite drawing awkwardly on the second row. RACHELS LEGACY (11) is resuming since a victory at Wagga in June. She finished off fast when an eye-catching third at a Shepparton trial last week and has the speed to figure in the finish. ARZALI ROCKSTAR (7) and CYCLONE JENNI (10) are both worth thought in multiple combinations. SELECTIONS: QUATRO MOTH (6), ISTHISTHEREALLIFE (8), RACHELS LEGACY (11), ARZALI ROCKSTAR (7)

OVERVIEW: CONCILIATE (5) followed a close up fifth in the Pink Diamond Stakes with a runaway success in fast time, where she led throughout. She is a speedy New South Wales trained filly and should give a forward showing. MY BETTOR HALF (7) is returning from a Tasmanian campaign, where she performed extremely well. She scored in a slick mile rate of 1.55.5 two starts ago then was spelled after her latest third. She is poorly drawn but has the class to test this field. ENOLA (8) settled midfield, came out four horses wide on the home turn and finished off well for fourth in the Pink Diamond Stakes last outing. She performs best when she is able to lead so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage but she is racing too well to dismiss. SWEET IRISH LOCH (6) is racing in career best form and set up a strong tempo when a brave third behind Seaside Boy last outing. She is a versatile filly and cannot be left out of calculations. SELECTIONS: CONCILIATE (5), MY BETTOR HALF (7), ENOLA (8), SWEET IRISH LOCH (6)

A small but competitive field kicks off tonight for the No More Than Two Lifetime Wins pacers, where TWILIGHT STORM (6) will be looking to show her class after a handy second in the Oaks last start and should take plenty of holding out late. A DRAGON FOR JOE (4) was an impressive 10-metre winner last start and looks to be back to his best after showing plenty of promise early in his career. Expect him to be right in the finish again. TAPPY (1) gets his chance from the pole draw after competing in some fairly strong company of late, including the Derby last start, and should appreciate the drop in grade. OMYBACNKNEES JUDGE (2) is a consistent pacer and looks the likely early leader, which should give him every opportunity again after a solid placing last start. WINNING BREW (3) and MY FATAL CHARM (5) would need to improve on their recent performances to be fighting out the finish, with the other four looking the main chances. Selections: TWILIGHT STORM (6), A DRAGON FOR JOE (4), TAPPY (1), OMYBACNKNEES JUDGE (2)

The open-class event of the night over the short mile brings together another small field, but it should still be a truly run affair. WAVES OF CHANCE (1) will again be looking to lead from start to finish, as he did four starts ago when winning in fast time. He disappointed when leading two starts back before over-racing due to gear issues last start, but at his best he could take plenty of running down. GO THE RED (2) added another victory to his record after being extremely consistent since arriving in the state and again looks a major player. BETTABLACK TIGER (3) arguably possesses the most talent in the field at his best, although he may be better suited over a longer trip. A genuinely run mile would enhance his chances, noting he has also undergone a stable change since his previous start. KEAYANG FITZY (4), WATERMELON SUGAR (5) and MAEBEE (6) will need to improve on their recent performances to beat the favoured runners, but could sneak into the placings if those ahead of them overdo things throughout. Selections: GO THE RED (2), BETTABLACK TIGER (3), WAVES OF CHANCE (1), WATERMELON SUGAR (5)

An even front row makes the speed map difficult to assess, with plenty of gate speed engaged and the early stages capable of playing out a number of different ways. ATOMIC BLACK (2) continues to work his way through the grades and get the job done, producing another strong victory last start despite copping interference early. PHOTO FIRST (3) battled on nicely for third when first up from a break and should take good improvement from that performance. CUZZY BRO (5), IRON CLAD (6) and ROCKANDAHARDPLACE (8) are always around the mark in these types of races and regularly find their way into the placings. SMOOTH REASON (4) has been thereabouts in features company of late and could be the one at odds if she brings her best form. POWER UP (7) did plenty of work early before fading over the longer distance last start and should appreciate coming back to this grade and being driven with a sit, although she will be relying on genuine tempo to bring her into the race late. CENTURIAN MISS (1) rises in class but is favoured by the pole draw. Selections: ATOMIC BLACK (2), PHOTO FIRST (3), POWER UP (7), CUZZY BRO (5)

The standing-start event brings together another even affair, where TULLAH GIRL (1) and SAPPHIRE GAMBLER (2) are normally the two best beginners from the front line and will be looking to make the most of their favourable handicaps again here. SPOOKY GIRL (5) pinged away from the tapes last start and was able to roll along at even quarters, although she does rise in grade here. ZEUS IMMORTAL (3) and HAMMER DAN (4) are consistent pacers who should be right in the finish if able to find positions on speed with cover. WILL HE PIKE (8) looks the best chance of the 10-metre runners and will again be relying on a nice run in transit and a good drive to allow him to finish off strongly. Selections: TULLAH GIRL (1), ZEUS IMMORTAL (3), WILL HE PIKE (8), HAMMER DAN (4)

Looks to be plenty of gate speed across the front row over the short distance in a race where it wouldn't surprise to see any runner pop up and win. MISS COLLANN (1) gets her chance to return to form after some fair efforts of late and should appreciate getting back to the short trip from the pole draw. Expect INTO THE HARKNESS (2) and MY WAY (3) to also push out early in search of the front or a position on speed, while MISTA EAGLE (7) could be lit up from the wide gate over his pet trip and give a sight at odds. JOHN VINCENT (5) was a clear black booker last start after making excellent ground from the back of the field in sharp time. Expect he may again be saved for one run, although he does strike an awkward draw. MUZZAME MATE (11) looks the best of the back-row chances, but it is always difficult to win from there over the short distance unless they go silly up front. GOODTIME OSCAR (8) could be the one at odds from a soft pegs draw if the gaps appear late. Selections: MISS COLLANN (1), JOHN VINCENT (5), MUZZAME MATE (11), GOODTIME OSCAR (7)

MIGHT AND TEMERITY (2) again uses the double claim to gain entry into this field and should be looking to be the first runner to the pegs over the 1680-metre trip after an okay third in slightly stronger company last start. KEAYANG LEXI (1) again draws the pole and has been thereabouts in races of this nature, so should get every opportunity from the draw. THE DEVILS FLAME (4) has been super consistent since arriving on the island and should appreciate the drop in class. However, the awkward draw may see him doing some work early and throughout, but he certainly can't be ruled out. LIKABLE ROGUE (9) gets a nice trailing draw and continues to knock on the door for another victory. The veterans JEREMY WELLS (10) and KENYA (11) both come off last-start victories and will be dangerous again, although they will be relying on genuine tempo throughout to allow them to finish home strongly over the short distance from their awkward draws. Selections: MIGHT AND TEMERITY (2), THE DEVILS FLAME (4), LIKABLE ROGUE (9), KENYA (11)

The second of the No More Than Two Wins events, where CRAYONS TO PERFUME (2) looks the best bet of the night following two strong performances since arriving in the state. Expect her to push forward from the draw, find the front and prove too strong for this opposition. JILLSTIGER (5) wasn't far away in the Oaks last start and arguably should have won her start prior with more luck in running, so looks the obvious danger if things fall her way in transit. WEE GEORGIE WOOD (8) again draws awkwardly on the back row but continues to race well, while it wouldn't surprise to see POST KEG (9) pop up and win if he brings his best form from a nice trailing draw behind the expected favourite. ALL ABOUT SADIE (6) continues to fill the placings in races of this grade and should again be running home strongly with a favourable run in transit. Selections: CRAYONS TO PERFUME (2), JILLSTIGER (5), POST KEG (9), WEE GEORGIE WOOD (8)

SHEMEANSBUSINESS (2) won nicely in fast time over the short distance two starts back and will be looking to replicate that performance here after a competitive fourth in the Oaks last start. Expect she may cop some early pressure from SHADES OF SILK (4), who possesses good gate speed and could ensure a solid tempo throughout. He clearly has ability when at his best. JUST LIKA DREAM (5) resumes from a spell after putting together some handy performances previously, although she strikes an awkward draw first up over the short distance. ROCKY STRIDE (8) is a handy three-year-old who has been competing in stronger company of late. He draws awkwardly but should be right in the finish with any luck in running. DIDYALOUSAROOSTA (9) is always earning cheques for connections and somewhat drops back in grade here. He gets his chance from a favourable trailing draw behind the expected leader. JET TO HEAVEN (1) broke on the first corner when fancied in the market last start but has produced some nice performances throughout his career and can be in the finish if he brings his best behaviour. Selections: SHEMEANSBUSINESS (2), ROCKY STRIDE (8), DIDYALOUSAROOSTA (9), JET TO HEAVEN (1)

ART HUNTSMAN (2) broke through for a well-deserved victory two starts back when leading throughout in good time over the mile, before being scratched at the start last time after running into interference in the score-up. He may cop some early pressure from WEONA EAGLE (5), who returned to her best form last start and possesses dazzling gate speed. LETSGOBRO (7) is another sharp beginner and finally broke through last start following a long run of outs, so there could be some genuine speed on early. MOVESLIKEALADY (8) can never be left out in these sorts of races and should be sneaking through the gaps late, as she usually does. LAID BACK (9) has been producing strong performances throughout this preparation and continues to threaten to break through, only to keep finding one better. He should get another good opportunity to return to the winner's circle here. Selections: LAID BACK (9), WEONA EAGLE (5), MOVESLIKEALADY (8), ART HUNTSMAN (2)

The low-class race of the night, where trainer Wayne Yole holds the key to the speed map with his three well-drawn runners all capable of showing good speed early. QUEENOFDANCE (1) won at big odds last start over her preferred mile distance, so it wouldn't surprise to see her take a sit on FEELINKINDALUCKY (2) rather than engage in an early battle. BARBETTE (3) has loomed as the winner a few times of late without getting the job done and gets another nice run in transit here from the handy draw. TALK IS CHEAP (7) resumes from a let-up and could be the runner that has a crack for the front early, despite drawing out wide. The veteran GOBSMACKED (8) will again be looking to finish strongly from the back row, while ROSE NOIRE (6) will be relying on genuine early tempo to bring her into the race late. Selections: FEELINKINDALUCKY (2), GOBSMACKED (8), BARBETTE (3), TALK IS CHEAP (7) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:NOTGUILTY (3) is resuming since a seventh at Bendigo back in November. His two starts were in a heat of the Breeders Challenge and in a heat of the Super Series so he met strong opposition and his trial form in South Australia has been sound. He should give a bold showing first up. BETTER THEN DAICOS (6) met stronger opposition when fourth behind Fantasy Flight at Melton, where he led out then took cover. This looks to be a more suitable assignment so an improved effort is expected. NO GOOD REASON (2) is a maiden from 11 starts but all of his five placed efforts have been over the sprint distance so he should be prominent throughout under these conditions. LAMBRO BUOY (1) is perfectly drawn for his Mildura debut and is a minor place chance. BACK: NOTGUILTY (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: NOTGUILTY (3), BETTER THAN DAICOS (6), NO GOOD REASON (2), LAMBRO BUOY (1)

OVERVIEW:SEASIDE LADY (7) ran a cracking race for second behind Royal Rockstar at Ballarat last outing. She has since transferred to astute South Australian mentor Ryan Hryhorec and she meets a very suitable assignment for her Mildura debut so she will prove very hard to beat. CAPTIVATE ME (1) attempted to lead throughout when he copped plenty of pressure in the back straight on the final occasion and battled on well for second behind You’ve Been Served last week. He is perfectly drawn over the sprint distance and is capable of going one better now. ALMIGHTY RUSH (3) has performed consistently in three starts to date and is worth a ticket each way. She raced without cover and battled on well for fourth behind The Ninja last outing. CRUEL MISTRESS (5) trailed the leader and battled on fairly well for third in the race won by You’ve Been Served last week. She has been placed at her past three starts and is a place chance again. BACK: SEASIDE LADY (7) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: SEASIDE LADY (7), CAPTIVATE ME (1), ALMIGHTY RUSH (3), CRUEL MISTRESS (5)

OVERVIEW: KYORETSU (1) is a fast beginner and should take catching from the pole position. He was aggressively driven from the outside of the second row to get up without cover when he won three starts ago and will appreciate his best draw for some time. SPORTSBOU (6) is poorly drawn but appears to be well placed against this line up. She finished off best from midfield when she scored at Mildura three starts ago and she met a strong field at her latest unplaced effort behind Savon De Roche. THE GOLDEN HOOK (8) makes his debut for trainer Naomi Kerr and his form in the South-East has been sound. He is capable of sprinting to the line quickly with the right trail forward and should be competitive at his first local attempt. UNITED (9) tends to race best when he is close to the speed so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage. He has been doing a lot of his racing against the open grade at Mildura so this appears to be a suitable assignment. SELECTIONS: KYORETSU (1), SPORTSBOU (6), THE GOLDEN HOOK (8), UNITED (9)

OVERVIEW: It is a strong field with several winning chances. LETSGO BIG GIRL (5) will appreciate the move to the front line and performs best over the sprint distance. She commenced on the inside of the second row and was badly blocked for a run when an unlucky fifth behind GUEST ARTIST (3) last week. She appears to be a good value hope. GUEST ARTIST (3) led throughout and scored under similar conditions last week. That was his best effort since coming from New South Wales and a repeat performance will see him going close again. WIPEOUT (9) produced his best run for some time when he was driven aggressively to find the lead and fought on strongly at Mildura last outing. He drops back to the second line now but is worth thought again. CEMETERY BAY (8) has been racing well against the open class at Mildura and will find this race to be slightly easier. He is worth thought along with the South Australian pacer MISS OUT (4). SELECTIONS: LETSGO BIG GIRL (5), GUEST ARTIST (3), WIPEOUT (9), CEMETERY BAY (8)

OVERVIEW:BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (2) is a South Australian trained pacer that boasts good gate speed and excels over the sprint distance. He led throughout at a Globe Derby victory three starts ago and raced fiercely in the front running role at his latest fourth in a handy mile rate of 1.58.2. He should give a bold showing over the short trip. HESASTAR (1) pressed forward to race without cover and battled on strongly for second behind CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (8) last week. He performs best when he is close to the speed so he is perfectly drawn to suit his racing pattern. SNEAKY PHILTRA (7) finished off reasonably well for fourth last week. Her form prior was sound and she was a runaway winner at Mildura on July 31 so she must be respected. ACCELERE (6) appeared to have his chance at his Mildura return last week but he was heavily supported ($1-45fav!) and he performed well at the trials prior so he cannot be dismissed. BACK: BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (2), HESASTAR (1), SNEAKY PHILTRA (7), ACCELERE (6)

OVERVIEW: MAJOR LINCOLN (9) commenced from the inside of the second line, settled three back on the markers and was caught behind tiring horses before storming home to win impressively at Mildura last week. This is a field of similar standard and he should prove hard to hold out again. KEAYANG CRIPPA (5) pushed forward to race without cover, took on the leader a long way from home and drew clear on the home turn before being run down by MAJOR LINCOLN (9) last week. His effort was sound and he looms as a strong winning chance again. FLEUR BELLA (6) is a former New South Wales pacer, which joins trainer Naomi Kerr. She is yet to win in 11 starts for the season but she did post a mile rate of 1.53.7 when she scored at Newcastle in July 2025 so she would be highly competitive at her best form. EGBERT (4) finished off well when a close second behind PUNTO CALIENTE (8) two starts ago and has claims from his reasonable draw. SELECTIONS: MAJOR LINCOLN (9), KEAYANG CRIPPA (5), FLEUR BELLA (6), EGBERT (4)

OVERVIEW: CELESTIAL NEBULAE (11) came from a rearward position and produced a powerful finishing burst when a big winner at Charlton last outing. That was his second run back from a long spell and he should continue to improve with race fitness so he must be respected. LISTEN TO THE HAND (8) led throughout at a Mildura victory when resuming since August 2025 then followed with a close up fourth at Swan Hill. He joins trainer Naomi Kerr and looms as one of the leading chances again. BERSAGLIERE (7) was resuming since November when second at Gawler. He should strip fitter from that performance and boasts a consistent record so he cannot be dismissed. MY BELLA (1) ran a sharper race at her second run back from a break and is perfectly drawn so she is not without a chance. SELECTIONS: CELESTIAL NEBULAE (11), LISTEN TO THE HAND (8), BERSAGLIERE (7), MY BELLA (1)

OVERVIEW: VINNY ROCK (11) is a versatile pacer, which has performed well at Mildura previously and maintains a consistent form line. He finished fourth behind the smart pacer Co Captain at Ballarat last outing and is capable of overcoming the extreme draw. CAULONIA TERROR (7) was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off strongly for an eye-catching third behind Just Incredible last week. He has done well since dropping back into a workable class and should be finishing off strongly again. ROYAL ROCKSTAR (5) was able to find the lead shortly after the start and held off his rivals to win at Ballarat on August 05. He broke stride when looking to find a forward position shortly after the start and lost his chance last week. He should be competitive under these conditions if he delivers a fool proof display. WHITEHAVEN BEACH (1) and RUBBLEONTHEDOUBLE (10) are both capable of showing up without surprising. BACK: VINNY ROCK (11) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: VINNY ROCK (11), CAULONIA TERROR (7), ROYAL ROCKSTAR (5), WHITEHAVEN BEACH (1)

OVERVIEW: LENARD ESS (9) is a real stable favourite of trainer Jess Tubbs and he landed a 19th career win at Melton last Friday when driven perfectly by James Herbertson. He led, handed up and then sprint-landed to a powerful victory as a short-priced favourite. He had gate one there, and while he won’t find the fence this time, he looks good enough to go close in what shapes as a very similar event. ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (3) is flying for trainer Brett Cole and came from off speed to land his second-straight victory in slightly easier grade last Friday. He’s stepping up a shade in class here, but must be regarded as a winning chance based on his current form. Stablemate GOODTIME MAE (2) got home well from back in the field from a horror draw to finish fifth in the same race and draws to settle much closer this time, while WICHITA KANSAS (5) was a winner two starts back here at Melton and ran soundly for fourth behind LENARD ESS (9) last time. He’s some chance along with FREAK OUT (7) and WOODLEA DIEGO (4), who would need luck but are capable. BACK: LENARD ESS (9) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS: LENARD ESS (9), ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (3), GOODTIME MAE (2), WICHITA KANSAS (5)

OVERVIEW: SMACK BANG BART (6) won a qualifier and final of the rich Nutrien series to start his career and then tackled the Group 1 Protostar slot race in Queensland, where he finished down the track as an $8 chance. He was beaten as a short-priced favourite by the handy Boystrous at Wagga following a month away from the races on August 19, but looks very handy and is the horse to beat in this opening heat of the Vicbred Super Series for two-year-old colts and geldings. LETITRIDELUV (3) won smartly on debut when running down a handy one in La Cantatrice and then closed well for second before a break. He’s trialled up nicely with wins at Melton and Geelong ahead of this first-up assignment and should run well. FULLY RECKLESS (2) has victories at Mildura and Wagga to his name from three career outings and also trialled nicely at Shepparton recently, while SOHO CRUZA (5), who hails from the powerful Michael Stanley stable, and ALLOA (4), who won on debut at Kilmore, should also be respected. SELECTIONS: SMACK BANG BART (6), LETITRIDELUV (3), FULLY RECKLESS (2), SOHO CRUZA (5)

OVERVIEW: SOME HIGH (5) might have the gate speed and barrier draw to cross to the fence and lead this assignment, which could be the winning move. He led, handed up and just couldn’t reel in stablemate Cardigan Sniper at Melton latest, which followed a front-running win at Melton and solid third placing in the hot Rising Star feature at Ballarat. Not sure he’s a star, but he might get the right run to pinch this Vicbred heat. KINGS GALLERY (7) is a very handy customer from the Chris Svanosio stable who has backed up his four successive runner-up placings to Emma Stewart rivals with two dominant wins since returning from a break. From a better gate I’d probably have him on top, but seven makes it tricky. SOHO BELLAGIO (6) won his debut start at Menangle as a short-priced favourite by a huge 24.7m margin in impressive style and he looks well and truly above average, while the honest and experienced BAYSTYLE (3), CRIPPA (8) and first-starter KELROSE CULLEN (4) might not be major winning hopes but are others to consider for wider exotics. SELECTIONS: SOME HIGH (5), KINGS GALLERY (7), SOHO BELLAGIO (6), BAYSTYLE (3)

OVERVIEW: CARDIGAN SNIPER (3) looks set to run a short-priced elect after a great start to his career which has included feature wins in the rich APG final and Youthful Stakes last time out at Melton. There, he was able to work to the front and win despite some wayward manners. You’d anticipate that he finds the top again, and from there he’s the horse to beat. LAKE COMO (4) chased him home for third in the Youthful Stakes in what was a brave effort off the pegs and his debut win from three back the fence at Maryborough was brilliant. He’s a nice type and key danger, as is CARDIGAN SNIPER’S (3) stablemate AUSTON (7), who won by panels on debut at Hobart before being run down late at Launceston. A big watch first-up in Victoria. STERLING GIGI (1) broke his maiden in good style last week at Kilmore following a nice second to the smart Kings Gallery and he can figure from the good draw. SELECTIONS: CARDIGAN SNIPER (3), LAKE COMO (4), AUSTON (7), STERLING GIGI (1)

OVERVIEW: Cracking start to the Vicbred Super Series for the two-year-old fillies, with a number of horses bringing in great form. SOHO ASTER (1) won a heat of the Gold Tiara before placing second in the Group 1 final, and returned from a freshen with a narrow victory at Menangle on August 18. She has good gate speed, a pole draw and might be the horse to beat from the front. DECOUPAGE (7) also brings impressive New South Wales form to Victoria. She was second on debut in the Pink Bonnet Stakes at Menangle in May and ran a great second in the $200,000 Nutrien series final at Wagga later that month before breaking her maiden first-up last Friday at Newcastle by a whopping 18.4m. She looks a key contender, as does TEERDEE (5) who is returning from a spell. She closed her last campaign with a midfield placing (after coming from a mile back at the bell) in the Nutrien final and ran a number of good races despite tough trips before that. DREAMS FOREVER (6), who failed after a tough run as favourite on debut at Maryborough on August 3, and LA CANTATRICE (2), who was very impressive winning the Youthful Stakes at Melton on August 15, are the other fancies. SELECTIONS: SOHO ASTER (1), DECOUPAGE (7), TEERDEE (5), LA CANTATRICE (2)

OVERVIEW: IDEAL FRANKIE (4) stamped herself as a star of her age group with massive 21.8m, 46.9m and 42.6m wins in her first three race starts, which included victory in the rich APG series at Melton in late June. That earned her a place in the Group 1 Protostar slot race at Albion Park, where she ultimately failed and finished towards the back of the field. She’s been freshened and looks clearly the horse to beat. SOHO SPARKLE (2) galloped out of play as favourite in a heat of the Gold Tiara on debut in March and heads here on the back of a good second placing at the Menangle trials recently, while SHES CAPTIVATING (3) won a trial at Ballarat over HEAVENLY GEM (6) on August 19 but there was no vision of that hit-out so it’s hard to weigh up the performances. CARTIMANDUA (5) wasn’t overly fancied by punters on debut at Shepparton, but ran well for third and can be included for the back end of trifectas and First 4s. SELECTIONS: IDEAL FRANKIE (4), SOHO SPARKLE (2), SHES CAPTIVATING (3), HEAVENLY GEM (6)

OVERVIEW: KAHULA (1) will start a very warm favourite here for Emma Stewart and Mark Pitt from the barrier one draw. Her form lines are outstanding from four career starts, including a dominant victory in the $200,000 Nutrien series final in May and a great third, beaten just a head, in the Group 1 Protostar at Albion Park in July. Her gate speed is a little query, but she should ultimately end up in front and prove too classy. ONELOOK (2) appeared the winner of the Youthful Stakes at Melton on August 15, and despite being worn down late by La Cantatrice, it was a great effort. She’s a leading contender for second place, alongside New South Wales visitor LATHER ME UP (7), who is first-up following a closing third in the Group 1 Gold Tiara, and MY ROCKING HORSE (8), who has run two good second placings – beating home ONELOOK (2) on one occasion – to start her career. SELECTIONS: KAHULA (1), ONELOOK (2), LATHER ME UP (7), MY ROCKING HORSE (8)

OVERVIEW: MAJESTIC MONARCH (8) caught the eye with a good third behind BUSLIN BRODY (5) first-up after more than a year away from the races at Kilmore on August 13, then was backed off the map before leading and turning the tables on that horse with a dominant victory at the same track last week. Harder here from the back row, but he looks very tough to hold out based off that recent effort. The old boy BUSLIN BRODY (5) is in great form and has obvious claims given he beat the on-top selection and ran well from the back of the field subsequent to that, SHAQ THE ANVIL (2) led and defeated Joe Lou in easier grade at Ballarat last week and that horse has won again since, and while STRAIGHT TO THETOP (4) was a little disappointing from behind the leader at Shepparton on Tuesday, she was only beaten by a neck to BUSLIN BRODY (5) in that recent race and had won prior to that. She looks a chance of finding the front and would be a major player if she found it. BACK: MAJESTIC MONARCH (8) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: MAJESTIC MONARCH (8), BUSLIN BRODY (5), SHAQ THE ANVIL (2), STRAIGHT TO THETOP (4)

OVERVIEW: SWEET FLORABEL (7) was well fancied on debut at Melton last Friday night, and while not much went right for her, she ran a cracking race for third. She galloped at the start and lost significant ground, chased hard to settle last and was forced wide down the back straight when making her run. She did a great job to only be beaten around 8m by Fantasy Flight and Sweetsugarcandyman, who have both shown good potential. Confident she gets the job done here in a very suitable maiden. DIAMOND CHIPP (2) has hit the line well in all three career starts from back in the field to be beaten less than 10m on each occasion and draws well here, SMOKEN HEAVEN (4) hasn’t beaten a runner home his past two but did manage a close-up third to Farroh Joe before that, while ROBLEN DEMON (5) produced a career-best second placing last start at Geelong but did find the pegs there and it might not be the case from gate five this time around. BACK: SWEET FLORABEL (7) – 7 units (win) SELECTIONS: SWEET FLORABEL (7), DIAMOND CHIPP (2), SMOKEN HEAVEN (4), ROBLEN DEMON (5) 10-UNIT GAME PLAN R1 #9 LENARD ESS – 1 unit (win) R8 #8 MAJESTIC MONARCH – 2 units (win) R9 #7 SWEET FLORABEL – 7 units (win) EARLY QUADDIE 2,3,4,5,7,9/2,3,6/5,6,7/3 QUADDIE 1,2,5,6,7/4/1/2,4,5,8 Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by
